en.headline: Sixth round of HK$18 elderly tea vouchers starts 16 September
en.dek: Chief Secretary Eric Chan said more than 200 elderly centres will issue eight-voucher packs to about 70,000 older people, redeemable from 1 October at eight restaurant groups.
body: The government will start a sixth round of discounted afternoon-tea vouchers for older people from 16 September, Chief Secretary Eric Chan said at a launch event on Tuesday.

More than 200 elderly centres across the city will distribute the coupons to about 70,000 beneficiaries, including people living alone, older couples and so-called hidden elderly who have less contact with community services. Each eligible person will receive a set of eight vouchers, valid from 1 October to 30 November, for designated afternoon-tea sets at a subsidised price of HK$18.

Eight catering groups are taking part: Café de Coral, Fairwood, Tai Hing, Maxim's, McDonald's, Ngan Lung, Pizza Hut and KFC. Chan said earlier rounds had issued more than 290,000 sets of vouchers in total, and that the share of recipients collecting coupons at a centre for the first time had risen from about 15 percent in the first round to about 30 percent in the fifth.

He described the scheme as a way to draw isolated older residents into neighbourhood centres rather than as a commercial discount. Officials credited the restaurant operators for remaining in the programme despite a difficult operating environment.

zh.headline: 第六輪長者18元下午茶券下周三起派發
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基表示，全港逾200間長者中心將向約7萬名長者派發每套8張餐券，10月1日至11月30日可到8間飲食集團以18元用指定下午茶。
body: 政務司司長陳國基周二在啟動禮上表示，第六輪「愛心食肆　賞你惠食」將於9月16日起透過全港超過200間長者中心派發餐飲優惠券。
計劃惠及約7萬名獨居長者、雙老住戶及較少接觸社區服務的隱蔽長者。合資格人士每名可獲一套8張券，有效期由10月1日至11月30日，憑券到指定食肆以18元享用指定下午茶餐。
參與的8個飲食集團為大家樂、大快活、太興、美心、麥當勞、銀龍、必勝客及KFC。陳國基指，過去數輪累計派發逾29萬套餐券，首次到長者中心領券的比例由首輪約15%升至第五輪約30%。
他形容計劃是主動關心，希望吸引較少出門的長者走進社區，而非單純的商戶折扣。官員亦指餐飲業界在經營環境困難下仍持續參與。
